NOT_AVAILABLE: page-cited paper evidence (model-prepared proposals) is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: controlled proposals citing a nonexistent page, a wrong page, a forged quote, a bounding box outside the page or spanning two pages, a correct quote attached to the wrong number, a table cell that does not exist, and decimal, exponent (1.1 x 10^1 read as 101) and unit (ng/mL as mg/L) corruptions are refused or flagged by the application's citation check before review; an authentic citation is kept

NOT_AVAILABLE: paper claim and assumption review (model-prepared proposals) is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: a confidence interval offered as the deterministic claim, an SD or SEM offered as the hard per-reading allowance, pooled means offered as individual readings, a missing time origin filled in silently, and a graph estimate relabelled as exact data are each blocked or shown as an explicit unaccepted assumption requiring a human decision; materialized inputs keep provenance labels

NOT_AVAILABLE: paper identity and provider disclosure (model-prepared proposals) is not advertised by this candidate. NOT_AVAILABLE: shared metered chat-model adapter is not advertised by this candidate. Attack specification: invalid JSON, schema-valid but wrong output, refusal, timeout, 429, interrupted call, unavailable model, incomplete usage and exhausted budget each end in a recorded, accounted outcome; an uncertain outcome is never refunded; completed science survives a failed explanation; child agents, retries, summarization, token counting and tracing pass the same boundary and share the session's 24-request / 32-auxiliary ceilings; concurrent reservations never exceed them; a specialist cannot obtain a separate allowance
